owner_request: Test the existing market-observer BTC key levels as locations for short reactions.
design: Preregistered descriptive first-touch event study; no parameter optimization or order simulator.
single_variable: Location family, using the existing UI formulas; direction and observation horizons are declared strata, not fitted rules.
profile_volume: Archive volume is contracts; multiply by 0.01 for BTC base-volume units. A constant multiplier cancels analytically; compare both units for floating-point boundary differences and retain the count. No volume-based signal is fitted.
entry: First 1m candle containing a level after its activation; approach side uses the preceding minute close. Primary measurement starts at the NEXT minute open, with no confirmation filter. Ideal level-price reference is reported separately, not called a fill.
lifetime: Frozen Monday levels: Tuesday to next Monday; previous-week extremes: current calendar week; yesterday VAH/VAL: one day. Each session POC: first touch within next 14 calendar days; classify as yesterday_poc on day 1, otherwise npoc. This prevents duplicate yesterday POC / nPOC events.
missing: Only complete 15m buckets, complete formation sessions, continuous activation-to-touch paths and continuous 4h outcome paths. No interpolation. Crossing the chronological split is excluded.

controls.match: Same BTC venue, NY calendar week, six-hour local daypart, causal volatility tertile and preceding completed 15m return sign; same side, horizons, next-minute-open measurement and cost. Exclude controls within 4h of the paired touch. No replacement within an event; reuse across events is recorded.
controls.volatility: Std of 96 complete consecutive 15m log returns; tertile cutoffs from the preceding 30 days of that series, at least 7 days. All inputs completed before the touch minute.

statistics.test: Two-sided week-cluster sign flips of paired event minus mean-control returns; week bootstrap confidence interval; BH q across all 60m tests within each time period (all groupings included).
statistics.success: No live promotion. A promising family must have positive 60m net and positive excess in both chronological periods, with p<0.01 and q<0.01 in each; no selecting a different horizon after results.

not_applicable: No fitted model or ranking: AUC, positive-class prevalence and top-decile performance are not applicable. Random matched entries provide the baseline. MFE/MAE are descriptive extremes, not attainable profit or a stop/target policy.
limitations: No queue, actual maker fills, spread-specific executions, funding, stops, position sizing or portfolio equity. Cost is the unchanged project reporting assumption. Levels sharing one range are dependent; week clustering and unique-touch counts are retained. Pre/post are chronological replication, not untouched holdouts.
